ENGINE_ACCOUNTING_AXIS.claim_disclaimer: Means no reproducible accounting/simulator defect was detected in tested scope; does NOT claim 'no bugs anywhere'.

hypotheses_table.cohort_overlap_and_censoring: 28/233 filled trades censored open at 180m; 2/233 unresolved data gap.
competing_explanations: Entry trigger may lack directional predictive edge regardless of TP/SL ratio (even direction-inverted symmetric SL/TP remains deeply negative: -298.4195 USD).

Shortening TP without pre-registered causal control can merely trade lower hit distance for smaller win payoff while keeping negative expectancy (as observed descriptively in E3: -439.0423 USD / -0.8628R).
hypotheses_table.observed_metric: median_SL=2.38 USD vs median_TP=24.05 USD (median Gross R:R=8.9172x)

hypotheses_table.cohort_overlap_and_censoring: Conditioned post-hoc on realized LOSS subset (196/203); excludes 28 censored trades.
competing_explanations: Under a zero-drift random walk, a large fraction of trades that eventually hit -1x SL first excursion past +1x SL before reversing; observing 86/196 (43.88%) does NOT prove a partial-TP or trailing-stop rule would produce positive net expectancy after fees.
hypotheses_table.observed_metric: 86/196 (43.88%) losses reached >=1.0x SL favorably within 20 bars before stopping out
hypotheses_table.time_horizon: First 20 M1 bars post-entry (post-hoc descriptive only)
unmatched_confounders: random-walk excursion probability of reaching +1x SL before -1x SL is naturally high (~50% symmetric baseline)
selection on losers induces hindsight bias

hypotheses_table.cohort_overlap_and_censoring: Excludes 14.7151 USD accrued entry fees on 28 open trades and 1.6080 USD on 2 gap trades.
competing_explanations: Counterfactual zero-fee check proves baseline gross P&L is ALREADY -164.9541 USD (< 0) before fees. Reducing fees alone CANNOT make existing baseline fills profitable.
hypotheses_table.observed_count_and_denominator: 127/203 closed trades at modeled 0.04% taker fee
hypotheses_table.observed_metric: closed_fees=276.6577 USD (median 0.5611x planned risk; 127/203 trades >=50% planned risk)
unmatched_confounders: tight M1 stops force larger notional per $2.50 risk cap, mechanically magnifying notional fee

hypotheses_table.cohort_overlap_and_censoring: Modeled spread ($0.20) + slippage ($0.10); real L1 BBO & live slippage unobserved.
competing_explanations: Excess over $2.50 is a small mechanical slippage/fee overshoot (~$0.0574 max in modeled OHLCV), NOT the primary cause of -441.61 USD net loss, though live tail risk remains unquantified without L1/fill logs.
unmatched_confounders: unobserved real orderbook depth and weekend/news gap slippage could produce substantially larger live tails
